counting_unit: arithmetic operations / explicit scalar coefficient multiply-add loops
same_map_baseline: full per-mode truncated-kernel polynomial waveform iteration, already sharing its collective nonlinear RHS
exact_equivalence: weighted mean equals compressed mean in exact unrounded arithmetic at every sweep
full_output: O(pD) shared coefficient construction plus O(np) evaluation per requested full state
preprocessing: O(np), all independent initial amplitudes and frequencies retained
explicit_restricted_accuracy_class: p,D,S=O(log(1/epsilon)), yielding O(n log(1/epsilon)+log^3(1/epsilon)+R_out n log(1/epsilon))
storage: O(n+p+D), excluding retained evidence/repeated study outputs
precision: coefficient roundoff included in exact candidate residual; arithmetic bound not automatically bit-complexity or hardware timing bound
